verdict.rationale: Vercel provides an official REST API with OpenAPI spec, a CLI, and AI SDK-related docs (model access, agent tool creation) that AI-native developers can build against, but the evidence pack lacks a dedicated first-party AI SDK reference/package documentation or independent corroboration of SDK usage. missing for 10: dedicated AI SDK docs/package reference, independent/hands-on developer confirmation of building against the SDK, language coverage beyond JS/TS.
